profiles.concept_zh: 店铺、咖啡、露天剧场、公园、足汤和生态水景被放在同一大屋顶下。
profiles.concept_en: Yu no Eki Ohyu is a reference case for reading Design topic: 温泉街, Design topic: 足汤, local food, tourism. It can inform thesis thinking about mixed programs, operation, and place-making.
profiles.concept_ja: 温泉街の足湯、食、観光案内を組み合わせた小さな滞在拠点。短時間の休憩を地域交流へつなげる設計として読める。

assignments.evidence_note: Kengo Kuma and Associates identifies Yu no Eki Ohyu as a completed 2018 Akita project of 1,026 square metres and one floor. The architect describes it as a community center combining a shop, cafe, open-air theater, park, footbath and biotope beneath one large roof. Kazuno City identifies the same facility as Michi-no-Eki Oyu at Towada Oyu Aza Nakayachi 19, with roadside-station parking, charging, 24-hour toilets, market, cafe and footbath. The attached open-air theater is one secondary space and does not make the whole facility a theatre.
